name: data
label: File
help: The file to BitGraph. Map the file data from an earlier module (Google Drive, Dropbox, HTTP). It is hashed inside Make and only the hash is sent; the file's contents are never uploaded to BitGraph. Leave empty if you are supplying a Digest instead.

name: digest
label: Digest
help: Only if the file was already hashed somewhere else: its SHA-256 as base64. Make's own sha256(data; "base64") produces exactly this form. Leave empty when you have mapped a File above.

name: recordAgain
label: Record Again If Already Recorded
help: Off: a file already in the ledger comes back with its existing proof and nothing new is created, so a scenario that re-runs is safe. On: record the same bytes at a new causal position anyway (BitGraph Again).

name: attributionName
label: Submitter's Name
help: Optional note stored inside the signed proof. Self-attributed: BitGraph binds the claim cryptographically but does not check it, and it is shown as a submitter's note, never as verified identity.
